item.title: Rallying Cry – November 14, 2026
item.description: Green turtles are thriving again, Wales stunned New Zealand in rugby for the first time in 73 years, the Euclid space telescope just revealed a billion cosmic wonders, and Alaska just elected its first Democrat governor in over two decades.
